newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sporitelna expects share change - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech Sporitelna expects share change - CTK.

text.p: The head of Ceska Sporitelna a.s. said on Wednesday that his bank anticipated a major change in its share structure, expected as investment group Motoinvest seeks to sell its stake, the CTK news agency reported.
In an interview with CTK, Klapal said it soon expected a "larger" transfer of shares in "several days or weeks."
"After that, we want to name the new owners and call on them to publish their holdings in (Ceska Sporitelna)," it quoted Klapal as saying.

Klapal was reacting to statements by Motoinvest last week that it was looking to divest banking shares after the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s. and illiquidity at Agrobanka a.s. focused attention on the secretive investment group.
Motoinvest director Pavel Tykac said his group was in talks with unnamed foreign investors aiming to sell an undisclosed stake in Sporitelna.
Sporitlena and its shareholders have refused to disclose the current shareholding structure of the bank.
"I think that these changes (in ownership) can only be for the better," Klapal was quoted as saying.
